# Stream

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Stream`](gmeow-Stream.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Stream>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/observations`](../../slices/observations.md)

A time-ordered sequence of observations or samples produced by a sensor or platform over a time interval. The ordering of samples is implicit via their individual timestamps, not asserted as a list structure ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)). A stream is the canonical source from which a continuous trajectory may be derived by the solver layer.
